summary: Weekly product standup: API stability, onboarding, pricing, and release readiness.

lines.speaker: Jules Kim
lines.text: Morning everyone. Let's go round — Avery, API first.

lines.speaker: Avery Chen
lines.text: Rate limiting is done and in review. I finished the token bucket yesterday, it's waiting on Sky to sign off. Should ship Friday.

lines.speaker: Avery Chen
lines.text: No. Separately though — we have no request-size cap on the upload endpoint. Someone posted a 400 meg payload last week and it took the workers down. I'll add a hard limit.

lines.speaker: Jules Kim
lines.text: Yes please, that one bit us. Rowan, onboarding?

lines.speaker: Rowan Diaz
lines.text: Main flow is drafted. I'm also going to write the welcome email copy — that sits inside the onboarding revamp, it ships when that ships.

lines.speaker: Jules Kim
lines.text: Good, keep it under that card. Noor, pricing?

lines.speaker: Noor Haddad
lines.text: I'm going to refresh the pricing page copy this week. It's stale — still shows the old three tiers.

lines.speaker: Sky Patel
lines.text: Quick one — the nightly build alerts have been noisy. I'll check whether it's the flaky auth test and report back Wednesday.

lines.speaker: Sky Patel
lines.text: Also, going forward we should always run the full suite before a release, not just the smoke tests.

lines.speaker: Jules Kim
lines.text: Noted, that's a process thing — let's discuss separately.

lines.speaker: Wren Alvarez
lines.text: One more — I'd like a written spec for the usage-based billing idea before we commit to anything.

lines.speaker: Jules Kim
lines.text: I'll write that up. Anything else? No? Thanks all.
